89.speaker: Metal Gear
89.en: Kremlin map data entered. Heading for the church.
cards: Kremlin map data|entered. Heading|for the church.

8d.speaker: Gillian
8d.en: Fifty years to make up for in just twelve hours.
cards: Fifty years to make|up for in just twelve hours.

8f.speaker: Metal Gear
8f.en: Snow Cedar. We've entered the Snow Cedar area. Put on your nasal filters. Inhaling it is dangerous.
cards: Snow Cedar. We've|entered the Snow|Cedar area. Put on|your nasal filters.

91.speaker: Metal Gear
91.en: Radio contact will be impossible from here. Ready?
cards: Radio contact will|be impossible from|here. Ready?

96.speaker: Metal Gear
96.en: My scan shows no lock. It must be rusted shut.
cards: My scan shows no|lock. It must be|rusted shut.

97.speaker: Gillian
97.en: Well, they come and go underground.

9b.speaker: Metal Gear
9b.en: This is the process of covering a Snatcher's frame, its endoskeleton, with artificial skin.
cards: This is the process|of covering a|Snatcher's frame,

9c.speaker: Metal Gear
9c.en: First, they resize the bare Snatcher to match its victim.
cards: First, they resize|the bare Snatcher|to match its victim.

9d.speaker: Metal Gear
9d.en: Its shape and size are adjusted by extending or contracting its units and slots. They change its sex by replacing the sex unit. To copy the victim's face, they adjust the upper and lower jaws, cheekbones, temporal bones and teeth to match the data.

They change its sex|by replacing the|sex unit.
To copy the|victim's face, they|adjust the upper|and lower jaws,
cheekbones,|temporal bones and|teeth to match the|data.

9e.speaker: Gillian
9e.en: As Gibson said, this limits the size of people they can snatch.
cards: As Gibson said,|this limits the|size of people they|can snatch.

9f.speaker: Metal Gear
9f.en: They can only expand or change shape so far. They can't snatch children, the elderly or large men.
cards: They can only|expand or change|shape so far.
They can't snatch|children, the|elderly or large|men.

a0.speaker: Metal Gear
a0.en: Next, they cover the skeleton with muscle. Only skeletal muscle, of course.

a2.speaker: Metal Gear
a2.en: No. It seems to be a plastic gel whose surface responds mechanically. It converts chemical reactions into mechanical energy.
cards: No. It seems to be|a plastic gel whose|surface responds|mechanically.

a3.speaker: Metal Gear
a3.en: This is where they apply the troublesome artificial skin.
cards: This is where they|apply the|troublesome|artificial skin.

a4.speaker: Metal Gear
a4.en: Synthetic cells made with biotechnology and protein design are grafted on slowly to avoid rejection of the inorganic parts beneath.
cards: Synthetic cells|made with|biotechnology and|protein design are
grafted on slowly|to avoid rejection|of the inorganic|parts beneath.

a5.speaker: Gillian
a5.en: Defective skin that turns cancerous under UV light.
cards: Defective skin that|turns cancerous|under UV light.

a6.speaker: Metal Gear
a6.en: Finally, they implant hair on the head and body. They transplant artificial hair follicle cells, so the hair regrows even if it falls out.

so the hair regrows|even if it falls|out.

a7.speaker: Gillian
a7.en: What about scars, blemishes and burns?

a8.speaker: Metal Gear
a8.en: They're added at this stage, using the victim's data. Wrinkles and signs of age, too.
cards: They're added at|this stage, using|the victim's data.

a9.speaker: Gillian
a9.en: This is where they create human replacements from endoskeletons sent by the Kremlin. Then they send them into the city through the tunnels.

aa.speaker: Metal Gear
aa.en: And Queen Hospital maintains their artificial skin.

ab.speaker: Gillian
ab.en: But who's behind it? And why?

ac.speaker: Metal Gear
ac.en: Look over there, Gillian. Several Snatchers are already complete.
cards: Look over there,|Gillian. Several|Snatchers are|already complete.

ad.speaker: Gillian
ad.en: Look! The American president! The Japanese and British prime ministers!

af.speaker: Gillian
af.en: I knew it! They'll attack the summit and snatch every country's leaders at once!
cards: and snatch every|country's leaders at once!

b0.speaker: Metal Gear
b0.en: They intend to snatch you, the last JUNKER, then leave the city.

b1.speaker: Gillian
b1.en: Snatch the world's leaders, and the world is theirs. But it doesn't make sense. Their defective artificial skin should make global expansion difficult.
cards: Snatch the world's|leaders, and the|world is theirs.
Their defective|artificial skin|should make global|expansion difficult.

b2.speaker: Metal Gear
b2.en: Chin said they'd found a way to perfect their skin. Could something have happened?

b3.speaker: Gillian
b3.en: I don't know. But look how many Snatchers there are. They're certainly planning something new.
cards: I don't know. But|look how many|Snatchers there|are.

b4.speaker: Metal Gear
b4.en: This is definitely the Snatcher base, Gillian. Let's destroy it all!

b5.speaker: Gillian
b5.en: No! Jamie's still here! Metal, how much time is left?

b6.speaker: Metal Gear
b6.en: The summit has started. We're out of time. After the deadline, I can't help you anymore. I'll have to take you into custody.

After the deadline,|I can't help you|anymore.
I'll have to take|you into custody.

b7.en: All right. If the military strikes here, what weapon will they use?

b9.en: A particle beam? There'll be nothing left.

bb.en: Ask them for another hour, Metal! Even thirty minutes!
cards: Ask them for|another hour,|Metal! Even thirty|minutes!

bc.speaker: Metal Gear
bc.en: Understood. I'll do what I can.

bd.speaker: Gillian
bd.en: I'll rescue Jamie while you do that.
cards: I'll rescue Jamie|while you do that.

be.speaker: Metal Gear
be.en: Snow Cedar makes the signal unstable here. I'll go outside the area to contact them.

c0.speaker: Metal Gear
c0.en: Thirty minutes, Gillian. Promise you'll come back.
cards: Thirty minutes,|Gillian. Promise you'll come back.

c2.speaker: Metal Gear
c2.en: I'm sorry I couldn't be more help, Gillian.
cards: I'm sorry I|couldn't be more help, Gillian.
